svg.text: Chen notation — symbol key
Account
Rectangle: entity with its own identity.
Owns
Diamond: relationship between entities.
account_id
Underlined oval: key attribute. Plain oval: simple attribute.
EMI
Dashed oval: derived attribute, calculated from principal, rate and months.
Phone
Double oval: multivalued attribute (notation example only).
Our customer phone field holds one value, so it uses a single oval.
Dependent
Double rectangle: weak entity (notation example only).
Identified by an owner's key + its partial key; no weak entities in this schema.
Identifies
Double diamond: identifying relationship for a weak entity.
A partial key uses a dashed underline. It is not a globally unique primary key.
Composite attribute: one oval connected to component ovals. Example: KYC → verified, occupation, risk.
(0,N) optional many · (1,1) exactly one · (0,1) optional one. Minimum 1 means total participation.
